title: Downloads
intro: The {appName} desktop app for macOS and Windows. The newest build of each platform is on top; the server keeps the last {keep} builds of each.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy; select the text by hand.

macos.step1: Open the downloaded ZIP: it unpacks Modlight.app.
macos.step2: Drag Modlight.app into the Applications folder and open it.
macos.hint: If macOS says it cannot check the developer, open System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click Open Anyway.

windows.step1: Extract the ZIP (right-click it, Extract All).
windows.step2: Run Modlight.exe from the extracted folder.
windows.hint: If Windows SmartScreen stops it, click More info, then Run anyway.

empty: No builds for this platform yet
emptyHint: When a build for {platform} is published, it will be here.
emptyHintAdmin: A build appears here as soon as a build machine publishes it (see Publishing builds below).
deleteDesc: {platform} {version} ({filename}, {size}) disappears from this list and from the server. Nobody can download it afterwards.

publish.title: Publishing builds
publish.intro: Only administrators see this. Build machines publish with the publish token; a new build goes to the top of its card, and the server keeps the newest {keep} per platform and architecture, deleting older ones.
publish.tokenMissingHint: RELEASE_PUBLISH_TOKEN is not set on the server, so only administrators can publish (with their session or a full-scope API token). To let build machines publish, add it to the server's .env file (setup-local.sh generates one) and restart the server.
publish.start: Start the upload with the build's details. The answer names the upload and the chunk size.
publish.chunks: Send the file in chunks numbered 0, 1, 2, and so on, each at most chunkSize bytes (50 MiB).
publish.finish: Finish. The server checks the size and the SHA-256, then publishes the build; if either is wrong, the upload is dropped and has to start again.
